citations.claim: First violation: body 1 centre at x~19.69 with r=1.2 overshoots arena (20) by ~0.89 > 0.15 limit
One step before, body 1 stationary near right wall, then gains full 60 m/s in collision step
Incoming body 0 at max speed 60 m/s that transfers momentum to body 1

explanation: Head-on max-speed (60 m/s) body-body impact adjacent to arena boundary transfers ~60 m/s to body 1 (x=18, r=1.2, only 0.8 from wall). Within the same dt=1/30 step it travels ~2m to x~19.69, overshooting by 0.89. Boundary collision is not resolved after the body-body impulse within the same substep sweep/ordering, so body escapes in_arena check.
vision_note: The small blue body moves right and makes contact with the large red body parked near the right boundary. On the next step the large red body is pushed into the right wall and ends up half outside the arena while the small body separates.
